## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing and sector breadth (8/11) signals broad participation, offset by rising credit stress (Credit Spread 1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.49% → flat ABOVE TREND) and HYG/LQD divergence (HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND) — mixed forces justify NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress RISING: Credit Spread (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.49%) → flat ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD flag. Stocks vs Bonds SHOWING RESILIENCE: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND → flat.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-mixed: Dollar/UUP (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND → flat; TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND signals tighter duration preference; Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND keeps conditions neither clearly loose nor restrictive.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND. Tech showing strength too: XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary lagging: XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION; Staples weak: XLP (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum (XLK/XLF direction confirmed) showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND. EM resilient: EEM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION — regional dispersion increasing.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact: ARKK (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND. Crypto cooling: IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals strong: SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND. Copper/industrial signal mixed: CPER (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND but copper/gold ratio BELOW TREND → watch for demand confirmation.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy rally broad: BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND. Natural gas lagging but bouncing: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector participation (8/11) and VXX falling support risk-tolerance. DIVERGENCE: Credit metrics (Credit Spread +1.49% 1M) and LQD BELOW TREND introduce meaningful friction; several 1W vs 1M mismatches (FXI, XLY, VGK) are MINOR but worth watching.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND for cyclical/growth participation; reduce exposure to XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION and XLP (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND while monitoring credit (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND if oil strength persists; SKYY (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +21.23%) ABOVE TREND for cloud/AI flows. BEARISH: XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION if flows rotate.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY remains vulnerable without sustained demand.

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX/VXX ~19.36 / VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND (complacency marker). Credit Spread ~0.75 (1M: +1.49%) / HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND. Tech vs Financials pivot: XLK/XLF ratio 3.2670 (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +4.68%) ↑ rising.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Growth/momentum and energy showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND; XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk is rising credit stress and LQD weakness (LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND), which could cap upside.
